Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1305
Claimant:
Jon Johnson
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
March 1, 2024
Claim opened after a side impact at an intersection was reported by the claimant, who is not represented by an
attorney. The claimant reports a shoulder injury and states that the other vehicle entered the intersection while the
claimant had the right of way.
March 7, 2024
Police report on file confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the collision. The driver of the claimant's
vehicle lives with the policyholder and is listed as a covered household member under the policy.
March 12, 2024
Photos from the scene confirm the general position of both veihcles and the point of contact on the driver's side. No
independent witnesses have been identified, so the account rests on the parties and the police documentation.
March 18, 2024
Damage to the vehcile is mostly in line with the described impact. A few old scratches near the rear quarter panel
may predate this crash and are being noted separately for the estimate.
June 4, 2024
Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before the coverage start date. Underwriting records were reviewed
and show no prior claims on the vehicle.
July 24, 2024
The claimant later provided a few additional details about the seating position and the moment of impact, but the core
account has remained the same across each staetment taken so far.
August 4, 2024
The reported shoulder injury matches the kind and force expected from a side impact of this type. Medical records
show a usual course of treatment that tapered off as the claimant improved.
August 13, 2024
Medical history shows the claimant was treated for the same body area within the last two years. That prior condition
appears to add to the current complaints, and the medical reviewer is weighing its contribution separately from the
crash-related injury.
August 16, 2024
Overall the injury and vehicle damage fit the reported collision, with the prior shoulder condition and older scratches
flagged for separate handling. The file is ready for the next settlement review step.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
